summary: xAI launched an Automations feature in Grok that lets users describe a task once and have Grok execute it autonomously on a schedule or in response to an email trigger, using connectors and skills, then report back.

mechanisms.reason: The feature shifts Grok from a chat-driven tool to one that executes delegated, scheduled or triggered tasks autonomously without a user initiating each request.
mechanisms.quote: Describe a job once and Grok runs it on a schedule or when an email arrives, then reports back.
